146: static void shell_uart_rx_isr(int uartn, shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
147: {
148: 	u16   free_buff_len, rx_cnt = 0;
149: 	u8    rx_data;
150: 	int   ret = -1;
151: 
152: 	(void)uartn;
153: 
154: 	if(uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx >= uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx)
155: 	{
156: 	    free_buff_len = RX_BUFF_SIZE - uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx + uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx;
157: 	}
158: 	else
159: 	{
160: 		free_buff_len = uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx - uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx;
161: 	}
162: 
163: 	while(bTRUE)  /* read all data from rx-FIFO. */
164: 	{
165: 		ret = uart_read_byte_ex(uart_ext->uart_id, &rx_data);
166: 		if (ret == -1)
167: 			break;
168: 
169: 		rx_cnt++;
170: 
171: 		/* rx_buff_wr_idx == rx_buff_rd_idx means empty, so reserve one byte. */
172: 		if(rx_cnt < free_buff_len)  /* reserved one byte space. */
173: 		{
174: 			uart_ext->rx_buff[uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx] = rx_data;
175: 
176: 			uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx = (uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx + 1) % RX_BUFF_SIZE;
177: 
178: 		}
179: 		else
180: 		{
181: 			/* discard rx-data, rx overflow. */
182: 			uart_ext->rx_over_flow = 1; //  bTRUE; // rx overflow, disable rx interrupt to stop rx.
183: 		}
184: 	}
185: 
186: 	if(uart_ext->rx_indicate_callback != NULL)
187: 	{
188: 		uart_ext->rx_indicate_callback();
189: 	}
190: }
191: 
192: static void shell_uart_tx_isr(int uartn, shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
193: {
194: 	int   ret;
195: 	(void)uartn;
196: 
197: 	while(bTRUE)  /* write data to tx-FIFO. */
198: 	{
199: 		ret = uart_write_ready(uart_ext->uart_id);
200: 		if(ret != 0)
201: 			break;
202: 
203: 		/* previous packet tx complete, check ECHO before new packet. */
204: 		if((uart_ext->cur_packet == NULL) || (uart_ext->packet_len == 0))
205: 		{
206: 			if(uart_ext->echo_rd_idx != uart_ext->echo_wr_idx) /* tx echo firstly. */
207: 			{
208: 				uart_write_byte(uart_ext->uart_id, uart_ext->echo_buff[uart_ext->echo_rd_idx]);
209: 
210: 				uart_ext->echo_rd_idx = (uart_ext->echo_rd_idx + 1) % ECHO_BUFF_SIZE;
211: 
212: 				continue;  /* continue to ECHO next byte to tx-FIFO. */
213: 			}
214: 			else
215: 			{
216: 				if(uart_ext->list_out_idx != uart_ext->list_in_idx)
217: 				{
218: 					uart_ext->cur_packet = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].packet;
219: 					uart_ext->packet_len = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].len;
220: 					uart_ext->packet_tag = uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_out_idx].tag;
221: 					uart_ext->packet_tx_len = 0;
222: 				}
223: 				else
224: 				{
225: 					/* all packets tx complete. */
226: 					/* disable tx interrupt ? */  // disable TX firstly, then set tx_stopped to 1.
227: 					bk_uart_disable_tx_interrupt(uart_ext->uart_id);
228: 
229: 					uart_ext->tx_stopped = 1; /* bTRUE;*/  /* all data tranferred, tx stopped.*/
230: 					break;
231: 				}
232: 			}
233: 		}
234: 
235: 		if(uart_ext->packet_tx_len < uart_ext->packet_len)
236: 		{
237: 			uart_write_byte(uart_ext->uart_id, uart_ext->cur_packet[uart_ext->packet_tx_len]);
238: 
239: 			uart_ext->packet_tx_len++;
240: 
241: 			continue;  /* continue to TX next byte to tx-FIFO. */
242: 		}
243: 		else
244: 		{
245: 			/* sent the whole packet, notify app. */
246: 			if(uart_ext->tx_complete_callback != NULL)
247: 			{
248: 				uart_ext->tx_complete_callback(uart_ext->cur_packet, uart_ext->packet_tag);
249: 			}
250: 
251: 			uart_ext->cur_packet = NULL;
252: 			uart_ext->packet_len = 0;
253: 			uart_ext->packet_tx_len = 0;
254: 
255: 			/* to next packet. */
256: 			uart_ext->list_out_idx = (uart_ext->list_out_idx + 1) % TX_QUEUE_LEN;
257: 
258: 			continue;   /* continue to TX next packet. */
259: 		}
260: 	}
261: 
262: }
263: 
264: static void shell_uart_tx_trigger(shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext)
265: {
266: 	if(uart_ext->tx_suspend != 0)
267: 		return;
268: 
269: 	if(uart_ext->tx_stopped == 0)
270: 		return;
271: 
272: 	uart_ext->tx_stopped = 0;   // set tx_stopped to 0 firstly, then enable TX.
273:

356: static u16 shell_uart_write_async(shell_dev_t * shell_dev, u8 * pBuf, u16 BufLen, u16 Tag)
357: {
358: 	u16   free_items;
359: 	shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext;
360: 
361: 	if(shell_dev == NULL)
362: 		return 0;
363: 
364: 	uart_ext = (shell_uart_ext_t *)shell_dev->dev_ext;
365: 
366: 	if((pBuf == NULL) /*|| (BufLen == 0)*/)
367: 		return 0;
368: 
369: 	/* enqueue pBuf even if BufLen is 0, upper layer need tx-complete-callback to free this pBuf. */
370: 
371: 	if(uart_ext->list_out_idx > uart_ext->list_in_idx)
372: 		free_items = uart_ext->list_out_idx - uart_ext->list_in_idx;
373: 	else
374: 		free_items = TX_QUEUE_LEN - uart_ext->list_in_idx + uart_ext->list_out_idx;
375: 
376: 	/* list_out_idx == list_in_idx means empty, so reserved one item. */
377: 	if(free_items > 1)
378: 	{
379: 		uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_in_idx].packet = pBuf;
380: 		uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_in_idx].len  = BufLen;
381: 		uart_ext->tx_list[uart_ext->list_in_idx].tag  = Tag;
382: 
383: 		uart_ext->list_in_idx = (uart_ext->list_in_idx + 1) % TX_QUEUE_LEN;
384: 
385: 		shell_uart_tx_trigger(uart_ext);
386: 
387: 		return 1;
388: 	}

390: 	{
391: 		return 0;
392: 	}

396: {
397: 	u16		read_cnt = 0;

399: 	shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext;

406: 	if((pBuf == NULL) || (BufLen == 0))
407: 		return 0;
408: 
409: 	while(uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx != uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx)
410: 	{
411: 		pBuf[read_cnt] = uart_ext->rx_buff[uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx];
412: 
413: 		uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx = (uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx + 1) % RX_BUFF_SIZE;
414: 
415: 		read_cnt++;
416: 		if(read_cnt >= BufLen)

453: static u16 shell_uart_write_echo(shell_dev_t * shell_dev, u8 * pBuf, u16 BufLen)
454: {
455: 	u16    free_buff_len, wr_cnt = 0;
456: 
457: 	shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext;
458: 
459: 	if(shell_dev == NULL)
460: 		return 0;
461: 
462: 	uart_ext = (shell_uart_ext_t *)shell_dev->dev_ext;
463: 
464: 	if((pBuf == NULL) || (BufLen == 0))
465: 		return 0;
466: 
467: 	if(uart_ext->echo_wr_idx >= uart_ext->echo_rd_idx)
468:     {
469: 	    free_buff_len = ECHO_BUFF_SIZE - uart_ext->echo_wr_idx + uart_ext->echo_rd_idx;
470: 	}
471: 	else
472: 	{
473: 		free_buff_len = uart_ext->echo_rd_idx - uart_ext->echo_wr_idx;
474: 	}
475: 
476: 	/* echo_wr_idx == echo_rd_idx means empty, so reserved one byte. */
477: 	while(free_buff_len > 1)
478: 	{
479: 		uart_ext->echo_buff[uart_ext->echo_wr_idx] = pBuf[wr_cnt];
480: 		uart_ext->echo_wr_idx = (uart_ext->echo_wr_idx + 1) % ECHO_BUFF_SIZE;
481: 
482: 		free_buff_len--;
483: 
484: 		wr_cnt++;
485: 		if(wr_cnt >= BufLen)
486: 			break;
487: 	}
488: 
489: 	if(wr_cnt > 0)
490: 		shell_uart_tx_trigger(uart_ext);
491: 
492: 	return wr_cnt;
493: 
494: }

496: static bool_t shell_uart_ctrl(shell_dev_t * shell_dev, u8 cmd, void *param)
497: {
498: 	shell_uart_ext_t *uart_ext;
499: 
500: 	if(shell_dev == NULL)
501: 		return bFALSE;
502: 
503: 	uart_ext = (shell_uart_ext_t *)shell_dev->dev_ext;
504: 
505: 	switch(cmd)
506: 	{
507: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_GET_STATUS:
508: 			if(param == NULL)
509: 				return bFALSE;
510: 
511: 			u16   free_items;
512: 
513: 			if(uart_ext->list_out_idx > uart_ext->list_in_idx)
514: 				free_items = uart_ext->list_out_idx - uart_ext->list_in_idx;
515: 			else
516: 				free_items = TX_QUEUE_LEN - uart_ext->list_in_idx + uart_ext->list_out_idx;
517: 
518: 			if(free_items > 1)
519: 				*((u16 *)param) = free_items - 1;
520: 			else
521: 				*((u16 *)param) = 0;
522: 
523: 			break;
524: 
525: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_RX_RESET:
526: 			uart_ext->rx_buff_rd_idx = 0;
527: 			uart_ext->rx_buff_wr_idx = 0;
528: 			break;
529: 
530: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_TX_RESET:
531: 			uart_ext->list_out_idx = 0;
532: 			uart_ext->list_in_idx  = 0;
533: 
534: 			uart_ext->cur_packet = NULL;
535: 			uart_ext->packet_len = 0;
536: 			uart_ext->packet_tx_len = 0;
537: 
538: 			break;
539: 
540: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_FLUSH:
541: 			shell_uart_flush(uart_ext);
542: 			break;
543: 
544: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_TX_SUSPEND:
545: 			uart_ext->tx_suspend = 1;
546: 
547: 			// disable TX firstly, then set tx_stopped to 1.
548: 			bk_uart_disable_tx_interrupt(uart_ext->uart_id);
549: 
550: 			uart_ext->tx_stopped = 1;  /* suspend, tx stopped after fifo empty.*/
551: 
552: 			extern bool bk_uart_is_tx_over(uart_id_t id);
553: 			extern void bk_uart_wait_tx_over(uart_id_t id);
554: 			bk_uart_wait_tx_over(uart_ext->uart_id);
555: 
556: 			while((bk_uart_is_tx_over(uart_ext->uart_id) == 0) && (param != 0))
557: 			{
558: 			}
559: 			bk_uart_set_enable_tx(uart_ext->uart_id, 0);
560: 
561: 			break;
562: 
563: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_TX_RESUME:
564: 			if(uart_ext->tx_suspend != 0)
565: 			{
566: 				bk_uart_set_enable_tx(uart_ext->uart_id, 1);
567: 
568: 				// resume tx.....
569: 				uart_ext->tx_suspend = 0;
570: 				shell_uart_tx_trigger(uart_ext);
571: 			}
572: 			break;
573: 
574: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_RX_SUSPEND:
575: 			bk_uart_set_enable_rx(uart_ext->uart_id, 0);
576: 			break;
577: 
578: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_RX_RESUME:
579: 			bk_uart_set_enable_rx(uart_ext->uart_id, 1);
580: 			break;
581: 
582: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_SET_UART_PORT:
583: 			if(param == NULL) {
584: 				return bFALSE;
585: 			}
586: 			u8 uart_port = *(u8 *)param;
587: 			uart_ext->uart_id = uart_port;
588: 			break;
589: 
590: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_GET_UART_PORT:
591: 			if(param == NULL) 
592: 			{
593: 				return bFALSE;
594: 			}
595: 			*(u8 *)param = uart_ext->uart_id;
596: 			break;
597: 
598: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_GET_RX_STATUS:
599: 			if(param == NULL)
600: 				return bFALSE;
601: 
602: 			*((u16 *)param) = uart_ext->rx_over_flow;
603: 			uart_ext->rx_over_flow = 0; // clear it after read by user.
604: 
605: 			break;
606: 
607: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_SET_RX_ISR:
608: 			uart_ext->rx_indicate_callback = (rx_indicate_t)param;
609: 			if((rx_indicate_t)param != NULL)
610: 			{
611: 				bk_uart_enable_rx_interrupt(uart_ext->uart_id);
612: 			}
613: 			else
614: 			{
615: 				bk_uart_disable_rx_interrupt(uart_ext->uart_id);
616: 			}
617: 			break;
618: 		case SHELL_IO_CTRL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
619: 			uart_ext->tx_complete_callback = (tx_complete_t)param;
620: 			break;
621: 
622: 		default:
623: 			return bFALSE;
624: 			break;
625: 	}
626: 
627: 	return bTRUE;
628: }

469: #if CONFIG_UART_RX_DMA
470: static uint32_t uart_id_dma_read_fifo_frame(uart_id_t id, const kfifo_ptr_t rx_ptr)
471: {
472: 	//DMA stop
473: 	bk_dma_stop(s_uart[id].rx_dma_id);
474: 
475: 	//actual_trans length
476: 	uint16_t actual_trans_len = 0;
477: 
478: 	//update WRITE-Pointer by DMA write length
479: 	uint16_t dma_remain_length = bk_dma_get_remain_len(s_uart[id].rx_dma_id);
480: 
481: 	//check kfifo used data length
482: 	int before_kfifo_unused_size = kfifo_unused(s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]);
483: 
484: 	UART_LOGV("uart_id_dma_read_fifo_frame dma_remain_length[%d], before_kfifo_unused_size:%d\n",
485: 	 dma_remain_length, before_kfifo_unused_size);
486: 	if(before_kfifo_unused_size > 0) {
487: 		actual_trans_len = (before_kfifo_unused_size - dma_remain_length);
488: 	}
489: 
490: 	UART_LOGV("uart_id_dma_read_fifo_frame id[%d], actual_trans_len:%d\n", id, actual_trans_len);
491: 	//buffer over-wrap:
492: 	//i.e:when erase flash,CPU can't get instruction from flash then can't handle this function.
493: 	//after Flash erase complete, UART handler come but DMA has copy more then s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->size bytes data
494: 	if(actual_trans_len > s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->size)
495: 	{
496: 		//TODO:
497: 		BK_ASSERT(0);
498: 	}
499: 	else
500: 	{
501: 		__attribute__((__unused__)) uart_statis_t *uart_statis = uart_statis_get_statis(id);
502: 
503: 		//data has been saved in buffer by DMA, only update write pointer
504: 		rx_ptr->in += actual_trans_len;
505: 		rx_ptr->in = rx_ptr->in & rx_ptr->mask;
506: 
507: 		UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.in, rx_ptr->in);
508: 	}
509: 
510: 	int after_kfifo_unused_size = kfifo_unused(s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]);
511: 	if(after_kfifo_unused_size > 0) {
512: 		uint32_t dma_start_addr = (uint32_t)s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->buffer + rx_ptr->in;
513: 		bk_dma_set_dest_start_addr(s_uart[id].rx_dma_id, dma_start_addr);
514: 		BK_LOG_ON_ERR(bk_dma_set_transfer_len(s_uart[id].rx_dma_id, (uint32_t)after_kfifo_unused_size));
515: 		bk_dma_start(s_uart[id].rx_dma_id);
516: 	} else {
517: 		UART_LOGW("Software FIFO is full, please read the data\r\n");
518: 		bk_uart_set_enable_rx(id, 0);
519: 	}
520: 
521: 	return actual_trans_len;
522: }
523: #endif

525: static uint32_t uart_id_read_fifo_frame(uart_id_t id, const kfifo_ptr_t rx_ptr)
526: {
527: 	uint8_t read_val = 0;
528: 	uint32_t rx_count = sizeof(read_val);
529: 	uint32_t unused = kfifo_unused(rx_ptr);
530: 	uint32_t kfifo_put_cnt = 0;
531: 	__attribute__((__unused__)) uart_statis_t *uart_statis = uart_statis_get_statis(id);
532: 
533: 	//TODO: optimize flow ctrl
534: 	while (uart_hal_is_fifo_read_ready(&s_uart[id].hal, id)) {
535: 		/* must read when fifo read ready, otherwise will loop forever */
536: 		read_val = uart_hal_read_byte(&s_uart[id].hal, id);
537: 		// UART_LOGV("read val:0x%x, rx_count/unused: %d/%d\n", read_val, rx_count, unused);
538: 		if (rx_count > unused) {
539: 			if (!uart_hal_is_flow_control_enabled(&s_uart[id].hal, id)) {
540: 				UART_LOGW("rx kfifo is full, out/in:%d/%d, unused:%d\n", rx_ptr->out, rx_ptr->in, unused);
541: 				UART_STATIS_INC(uart_statis->kfifo_status.full_cnt);
542: #if CFG_CLI_DEBUG
543: 				extern void cli_show_running_command(void);
544: 				cli_show_running_command();
545: #endif
546: 			}
547: 		} else {
548: 			kfifo_put_cnt += kfifo_put(rx_ptr, &read_val, sizeof(read_val));
549: 			UART_STATIS_INC(uart_statis->kfifo_status.put_cnt);
550: 			UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.last_value, read_val);
551: 		}
552: 		unused = kfifo_unused(rx_ptr);
553: 	}
554: 	UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.in, rx_ptr->in);
555: 	UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.out, rx_ptr->out);
556: 
557: 	return kfifo_put_cnt;
558: }

1054:

1058: #if CONFIG_UART_PM_CB_SUPPORT	//this macro config set to n

1071: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_UART3);
1072: 	}
1073: #endif
1074: 
1075: 	pm_cb_conf_t enter_config = {
1076: 		.cb = (pm_cb)uart_enter_deep_sleep,
1077: 		.args = (void *)id
1078: 	};
1079: 	pm_cb_conf_t exit_config = {
1080: 		.cb = NULL,
1081: 		.args = (void *)PM_CB_PRIORITY_1
1082: 	};
1083: 	u8 pm_uart_port = uart_id_to_pm_uart_id(id);
1084: 
1085: 	bk_pm_sleep_register_cb(PM_MODE_DEEP_SLEEP, pm_uart_port, &enter_config, &exit_config);
1086: 
1087: #if CONFIG_SOC_BK7236XX || (CONFIG_SOC_BK7239XX) || (CONFIG_SOC_BK7286XX)
1088: 	uart_hal_disable_tx_interrupt(&s_uart[id].hal, id);
1089: 	uart_hal_clear_id_tx_interrupt_status(&s_uart[id].hal, id);
1090: 	uart_isr_register_functions(id);
1091: 	s_uart[id].hal.id = id;
1092: 	uart_hal_init(&s_uart[id].hal);
1093: #endif
1094: 
1095: #if (CONFIG_SYSTEM_CTRL)
1096: 	uart_interrupt_enable(id);
1097: #else
1098: 	icu_enable_uart_interrupt(id);
1099: #endif
1100: 
1101: 	uart_id_init_common(id);
1102: #if (CONFIG_SYSTEM_CTRL)
1103: 	if (config->src_clk == UART_SCLK_APLL)
1104: 		sys_drv_uart_select_clock(id, UART_SCLK_APLL);
1105: 	else
1106: 		sys_drv_uart_select_clock(id, UART_SCLK_XTAL_26M);
1107: 
1108: #else
1109: 	if (config->src_clk == UART_SCLK_DCO) {
1110: 		clk_set_uart_clk_dco(id);
1111: 	} else {
1112: 		clk_set_uart_clk_26m(id);
1113: 	}
1114: #endif
1115: 
1116: #if CONFIG_UART_RX_DMA
1117: 	if(config->rx_dma_en)
1118: 	{
1119: 		//DMA init RX
1120: 		uart_rx_dma_init(id);
1121: 	}
1122: #else	//avoid set err parameter.
1123: 	if(config->rx_dma_en)
1124: 	{
1125: 		UART_LOGW("uart(%d)Please enable MACRO CONFIG_UART_RX_DMA then set DMA enable parameter\n", id);
1126: 	}
1127: #endif
1128: 
1129: #if CONFIG_UART_TX_DMA
1130: 	if(config->tx_dma_en)
1131: 	{
1132: 		//DMA init TX
1133: 		uart_tx_dma_init(id);
1134: 	}
1135: #else	//avoid set err parameter.
1136: 	if(config->tx_dma_en)
1137: 	{
1138: 		UART_LOGW("uart(%d)Please enable MACRO CONFIG_UART_TX_DMA then set DMA enable parameter\n", id);
1139: 	}
1140: #endif
1141: 
1142: 	uart_hal_init_uart(&s_uart[id].hal, id, config);
1143: 	uart_hal_start_common(&s_uart[id].hal, id);
1144: 
1145: 	return BK_OK;
1146: }

1383: bk_err_t bk_uart_read_bytes(uart_id_t id, void *data, uint32_t size, uint32_t timeout_ms)
1384: {
1385: 	UART_RETURN_ON_NOT_INIT();
1386: 	UART_RETURN_ON_INVALID_ID(id);
1387: 	UART_RETURN_ON_ID_NOT_INIT(id);
1388: 	UART_PM_CHECK_RESTORE(id);
1389: 
1390: 	if (uart_id_is_sw_fifo_enabled(id)) {
1391: 		__attribute__((__unused__)) uart_statis_t* uart_statis = uart_statis_get_statis(id);
1392: 		GLOBAL_INT_DECLARATION();
1393: 		GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
1394: 		uint32_t kfifo_data_len = kfifo_data_size(s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]);
1395: 		/* Only kfifo_data_len=0, wait for semaphore */
1396: 		if (kfifo_data_len == 0) {
1397: 			UART_LOGV("kfifo is empty, wait for recv data\r\n");
1398: 			/* when sema_cnt=0, rx_blocked=true, otherwise rx_blocked=false */
1399: 			s_uart_sema[id].rx_blocked = true;
1400: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
1401: #if CONFIG_RTC_TIMER_PRECISION_TEST
1402: 			uint32_t ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&(s_uart_sema[id].rx_int_sema), BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
1403: #else
1404: 			uint32_t ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&(s_uart_sema[id].rx_int_sema), timeout_ms);
1405: #endif
1406: 			if (ret == kTimeoutErr) {
1407: 				if (!s_uart_sema[id].rx_blocked) {
1408: 					rtos_get_semaphore(&(s_uart_sema[id].rx_int_sema), timeout_ms);
1409: 				}
1410: 				GLOBAL_INT_DISABLE();
1411: 				s_uart_sema[id].rx_blocked = false;
1412: 				GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
1413: 				UART_LOGW("recv data timeout:%d\n", timeout_ms);
1414: 				UART_STATIS_INC(uart_statis->recv_timeout_cnt);
1415: 				return BK_ERR_UART_RX_TIMEOUT;
1416: 			}
1417: 		} else {
1418: 			GLOBAL_INT_RESTORE();
1419: 		}
1420: 
1421: 		kfifo_data_len = kfifo_data_size(s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]); /* updata kfifo data size */
1422: 		UART_LOGV("kfifo data length is %d.\n", kfifo_data_len);
1423: 		if (size >= kfifo_data_len) {
1424: #if CONFIG_UART_RX_DMA
1425: 			uint32_t dma_start_addr = (uint32_t)s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->buffer;
1426: 			uart_rx_dma_reset_dst_addr(id, dma_start_addr, s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->size);
1427: 			bk_uart_set_enable_rx(id, 1);
1428: #endif
1429: 			if (kfifo_data_len) {
1430: 				kfifo_get(s_uart_rx_kfifo[id], (uint8_t *)data, kfifo_data_len);
1431: 			} else {
1432: 				UART_LOGW("kfifo data is empty\n");
1433: 				UART_STATIS_INC(uart_statis->kfifo_status.empty_cnt);
1434: 			}
1435: 			UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.in, s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->in);
1436: 			UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.out, s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->out);
1437: 
1438: 			return kfifo_data_len;
1439: 		}
1440: 		kfifo_get(s_uart_rx_kfifo[id], (uint8_t *)data, size);
1441: 		UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.in, s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->in);
1442: 		UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->kfifo_status.out, s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->out);
1443: 
1444: 		return size;
1445: 	}else {
1446: 		int ret = 0;
1447: 		uint8_t rx_data;
1448: 		int read_count = 0;
1449: 		uint8_t *read_buffer = (uint8_t *)data;
1450: 	    int actual_bytes_to_read = size;
1451: 
1452: 		/* read all data from rx-FIFO. */
1453: 	 	while (actual_bytes_to_read) {
1454: 			ret = uart_read_byte_ex(id, &rx_data);
1455: 			if (ret == -1)
1456: 				break;
1457: 
1458: 			read_buffer[read_count] = rx_data;
1459: 			read_count++;
1460: 
1461: 			actual_bytes_to_read--;
1462: 		}
1463: 
1464: 		return read_count;
1465: 	}
1466: }

1625: static void uart_isr_common(uart_id_t id)
1626: {
1627: 	uint32_t int_status = 0;
1628: 	uint32_t int_enable_status = 0;
1629: 	uint32_t status = 0;
1630: 	UART_STATIS_DEC();
1631:

1633: 	int_enable_status = uart_hal_get_int_enable_status(&s_uart[id].hal, id);
1634: 	status = int_status & int_enable_status;
1635: 	uart_hal_clear_interrupt_status(&s_uart[id].hal, id, int_status);
1636: 	UART_STATIS_GET(uart_statis, id);
1637: 	UART_STATIS_INC(uart_statis->uart_isr_cnt);
1638: 
1639: 	if (uart_hal_is_rx_interrupt_triggered(&s_uart[id].hal, id, status))	//rx end or rx fifo full
1640: 	{
1641: 		//overflow,rx_para_err,rx_stop_err
1642: 		if(int_status & (BIT(2) | BIT(3) | BIT(4)))
1643: 		{
1644: #if (CONFIG_UART_RX_DMA)
1645: 			//TODO:Discard the RX FIFO data,set WR_PTR to RD_PTR
1646: 			if(s_uart[id].rx_dma_enable)

1649: 				s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->in = s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]->out;
1650: #if CONFIG_UART_ERR_INTERRUPT

1652: #endif
1653: 			}
1654: 			else
1655: #endif
1656: 			{
1657: 				int ret = 0;

1659: 
1660: 				/* read all data from rx-FIFO. */
1661: 				while (1)
1662: 				{

1668: 						#endif
1669: 						break;
1670: 					}
1671: 				}
1672: 			}
1673: 		}
1674: 
1675: 		UART_STATIS_INC(uart_statis->rx_isr_cnt);
1676: 		UART_STATIS_SET(uart_statis->rx_fifo_cnt, uart_hal_get_rx_fifo_cnt(&s_uart[id].hal, id));
1677: 		if (uart_id_is_sw_fifo_enabled(id))

1679: #if CONFIG_UART_RX_DMA

1686: 					if (s_uart_sema[id].rx_int_sema && s_uart_sema[id].rx_blocked)
1687: 					{
1688: 						rtos_set_semaphore(&(s_uart_sema[id].rx_int_sema));
1689: 						s_uart_sema[id].rx_blocked = false;
1690: 					}
1691: 				}
1692: 			}
1693: 			else
1694: #endif
1695: 			if (uart_id_read_fifo_frame(id, s_uart_rx_kfifo[id]) > 0)
1696: 			{
1697: 				if (s_uart_sema[id].rx_int_sema && s_uart_sema[id].rx_blocked)
1698: 				{
1699: 					rtos_set_semaphore(&(s_uart_sema[id].rx_int_sema));
1700: 					s_uart_sema[id].rx_blocked = false;
1701: 				}
1702: 			}
1703: 
1704: 			if (s_uart_rx_isr[id].callback)
1705: 			{
1706: 					s_uart_rx_isr[id].callback(id, s_uart_rx_isr[id].param);
1707: 			}
1708: 		}
1709: 		else if (s_uart_rx_isr[id].callback)

80: static void bk_printf_sync_port(char *prefix, const char *fmt, va_list args)
81: {
82: 	if(!printf_is_init())
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	char string[CONFIG_PRINTF_BUF_SIZE];
86: 
87: 	os_snprintf(&string[0], CONFIG_PRINTF_BUF_SIZE, "[SYNC]:%s", prefix);
88: 	string[CONFIG_PRINTF_BUF_SIZE - 1] = 0;
89: 
90: 	int   data_len = strlen(string);
91: 
92: 	vsnprintf(&string[data_len], CONFIG_PRINTF_BUF_SIZE - data_len, fmt, args);
93: 
94: 	string[CONFIG_PRINTF_BUF_SIZE - 1] = 0;
95: 	uart_write_string(bk_get_printf_port(), string);
96: }

120: static void bk_printf_port_ext_internel(int block_mode, int level, char *tag, const char *fmt, va_list args)
121: {
122: #define CPU_STR_LEN		4
123: #define MAX_TAG_LEN		8
124: #define MAX_INFO_LEN	14    /* 13 + 1(:) */
125: 
126: 	/*                  "cpux" + ":"       "Tag12345" + ":"    "X(1234567890)" + ":"   */
127: 	char    prefix_str[(CPU_STR_LEN + 1) + (MAX_TAG_LEN + 1) + (MAX_INFO_LEN) + 1];
128: 	int     data_len = 0;
129: #if CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG
130: 	int cpu_id = shell_get_cpu_id();
131: #else
132: 	int cpu_id = rtos_get_core_id();
133: #endif
134: 
135: 	prefix_str[0] = 0;
136: 	if (cpu_id >= 0)
137: 	{
138: 		const char *cpu_prefix = NULL;
139: 		int core_num = 0;
140: 
141: 		if (cpu_id == 0) {
142: 			cpu_prefix = CPU_PREFIX_CPU0;
143: 			core_num = 0;
144: 		} else if (cpu_id == 1) {
145: 			cpu_prefix = CPU_PREFIX_CPU1;
146: 			core_num = 0;
147: 		} else if (cpu_id == 2) {
148: 			cpu_prefix = CPU_PREFIX_CPU2;
149: 			core_num = 1;
150: 		} else {
151: 			cpu_prefix = "cpu";
152: 			core_num = cpu_id;
153: 		}
154: 
155: 		os_snprintf(&prefix_str[data_len], CPU_STR_LEN + 1, "%s%d", cpu_prefix, core_num);
156:     	data_len += strlen(cpu_prefix) + 1;  // +1 for the digit
157: 
158: 		prefix_str[data_len++] = ':';
159: 		prefix_str[data_len] = 0;
160: 	}
161: 
162: 	if((tag != NULL) && (tag[0] != 0))
163: 	{
164: 		strncpy(&prefix_str[data_len], tag, MAX_TAG_LEN);
165: 		prefix_str[MAX_TAG_LEN + data_len] = 0;
166: 
167: 		data_len = strlen(prefix_str);
168: 
169: 		prefix_str[data_len] = ':';
170: 		data_len++;
171: 		prefix_str[data_len] = 0;
172: 	}
173: 
174: 	os_snprintf(&prefix_str[data_len], MAX_INFO_LEN + 1, level_format[level], rtos_get_time());
175: 
176: #if CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG
177: 
178: 	if(s_printf_sync == 0)
179: 	{
180: 		shell_log_out_port(block_mode, level, prefix_str, fmt, args);
181: 	}
182: 	else
183: 	{
184: 		bk_printf_sync_port(prefix_str, fmt, args);
185: 	}
186: 
187: #else
188: 	bk_printf_sync_port(prefix_str, fmt, args);
189: #endif // #if CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG
190: }

215: void bk_printf(const char *fmt, ...)
216: {
217: 	int level = BK_LOG_DEBUG;
218: 	va_list args;
219: 
220: 	if(!printf_is_init())
221: 		return;
222: 
223: 	if(!s_printf_enable)
224: 		return;
225: 
226: #if CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG
227: 	if( !shell_level_check_valid(level) )  /* check here instead of in shell_log_out to reduce API instructions. */
228: 		return;
229: #endif
230: 
231: 	va_start(args, fmt);
232: 	MULTI_CORE_PRINTF_LOCK();
233: 
234: 	bk_printf_port_ext(level, NULL, fmt, args);
235: 
236: 	MULTI_CORE_PRINTF_UNLOCK();
237: 	va_end(args);
238: 
239: 	return;
240: }

253: 			if(result == 0)
254: 				return 1;
255: 		}
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	return 0;

516: 		/*    queue ascending in blk_len.    */

518: 			continue;
519: 
520: 		if(free_q->free_blk_num > 0)

522: 			free_blk_id = free_q->blk_list[free_q->list_out_idx];

533: 			*blk_tag = MAKE_BLOCK_TAG(free_blk_id, queue_id);

538: 		{
539: 			if(ovf_cnt_saved == 0)

541: 				free_q->ovf_cnt++;

593: static int merge_log_data(u16 blk_tag, u16 data_len)
594: {
595: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
596: 	{
597: 		return 0;
598: 	}
599: 
600: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(blk_tag);
601: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(blk_tag);
602: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
603: 	{
604: 		return 0;
605: 	}
606: 
607: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
608: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
609: 
610: 	u8		* src_buf = NULL;
611: 
612: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
613: 	{
614: 		src_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
615: 	}
616: 	else
617: 		return 0;
618: 
619: 	u16    pre_in_idx;
620: 
621: 	if(pending_queue.list_in_idx > 0)
622: 		pre_in_idx = pending_queue.list_in_idx - 1;
623: 	else
624: 		pre_in_idx = SHELL_LOG_PEND_NUM - 1;
625: 
626: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
627: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].blk_tag);
628: 	if(queue_id >= TBL_SIZE(free_queue))  /* not log buffer */
629: 	{
630: 		return 0;
631: 	}
632: 
633: 	u8		* dst_buf = NULL;
634: 	u16       buf_len = 0;
635: 
636: 	free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
637: 
638: 	if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
639: 	{
640: 		dst_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
641: 		buf_len = free_q->blk_len;
642: 	}
643: 	else
644: 		return 0;
645: 
646: 	u16       cur_len = pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len;
647: 
648: 	if((cur_len + data_len) > buf_len)  /* can be merged into one buffer? */
649: 		return 0;
650: 
651: 	memcpy(dst_buf + cur_len, src_buf, data_len);
652: 
653: 	pending_queue.packet_list[pre_in_idx].packet_len += data_len;
654: 
655: 	free_log_blk(blk_tag);  /* merged, free the log buffer. */
656: 
657: 	return 1;
658: }

699: /* call from cmd TX ISR. */
700: static int cmd_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
701: {
702: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
703: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
704: 
705: 	/* rsp ok ?? */
706: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID )    /* rsp. */
707: 	{
708: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
709: 
710: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
711: 		{
712: 			/* something wrong!!! */
713: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: in rsp.\r\n");
714: 		}
715: 
716: 		/* rsp compelete, rsp_buff can be used for next cmd/response. */
717: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.rsp_buf_semaphore);
718: 
719: 		return 1;
720: 	}
721: 
722: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID )    /* cmd_ind. */
723: 	{
724: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
725: 
726: 		if ( (pbuf != cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff) || (blk_id != 0) )
727: 		{
728: 			/* something wrong!!! */
729: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FAULT: indication.\r\n");
730: 		}
731: 
732: 		/* indication tx compelete, cmd_ind_buff can be used for next cmd_indication. */
733: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&cmd_line_buf.ind_buf_semaphore);
734: 
735: 		return 1;
736: 	}
737: 
738: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
739: 	{
740: 		/* it is called from cmd_dev tx ISR. */
741: 
742: 		if (blk_id == 1)
743: 		{
744: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_cmd_ovf_str)
745: 			{
746: 				/* something wrong!!! */
747: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
748: 			}
749: 
750: 			cmd_line_buf.cmd_ovf_hint = 0;
751: 
752: 			return 1;
753: 		}
754: 	}
755: 
756: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_FWD_QUEUE_ID )    /* slave buffer. */
757: 	{
758: 		#if defined(FWD_CMD_TO_MBOX)
759: 		if (log_handle_init_ok) {
760: 			set_fwd_state(blk_id);
761: 		} else {
762: 			result_fwd(blk_id);
763: 		}
764: 		return 1;
765: 		#endif
766: 	}
767: 
768: 	return 0;
769: }

785: /* call from log TX ISR. */
786: static int log_tx_complete(u8 *pbuf, u16 buf_tag)
787: {
788: 	u16     block_tag;
789: 	u8      queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(buf_tag);
790: 	u16     blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(buf_tag);
791: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
792: 
793: 	if( queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID )    /* fault hints buffer, point to flash. */
794: 	{
795: 		/* it is called from log_dev tx ISR. */
796: 
797: 		if (blk_id == 0)
798: 		{
799: 			if(pbuf != (u8 *)shell_fault_str)
800: 			{
801: 				/* something wrong!!! */
802: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:t-%x,p-%x\r\n", buf_tag, pbuf);
803: 			}
804: 
805: 			return 1;
806: 		}
807: 	}
808: 
809: 	if (queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))   /* from log busy queue. */
810: 	{
811: 		/* it is called from log_dev tx ISR. */
812: 
813: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
814: 
815: 		block_tag = log_busy_queue.blk_list[log_busy_queue.list_out_idx];
816: 
817: 		if( ( buf_tag != block_tag ) || (blk_id >= free_q->blk_num) ||
818: 			( (&free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len]) != pbuf) )
819: 		{
820: 			/* something wrong!!! */
821: 			/*        FAULT !!!!      */
822: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "FATAL:%x,%x\r\n", buf_tag, block_tag);
823: 
824: 			return -1;
825: 		}
826: 
827: 		/* de-queue from busy queue. */
828: 		//log_busy_queue.list_out_idx = (log_busy_queue.list_out_idx + 1) % SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM;
829: 		if((log_busy_queue.list_out_idx + 1) < SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM)
830: 			log_busy_queue.list_out_idx++;
831: 		else
832: 			log_busy_queue.list_out_idx = 0;
833: 
834: 		log_busy_queue.free_cnt++;
835: 
836: 		/* free buffer to queue. */
837: 		free_log_blk(block_tag);
838: 
839: 		if (log_buf_semaphore != NULL) {
840: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&log_buf_semaphore);
841: 		}
842: 
843: 		return 1;
844: 	}
845: 
846: 	if (queue_id == SHELL_DYM_QUEUE_ID) {
847: 		dynamic_log_node *node = dynamic_list_pop_front();
848: 		free_list_push_front(node);
849: 		if (log_buf_semaphore != NULL)
850: 			set_shell_event(&shell_log_event, SHELL_EVENT_DYM_FREE);
851: 		return 1;
852: 	}
853: 	return 0;
854: }

1028: /* call this in interrupt !* DISABLED *! context. */
1029: static void tx_req_process(void)
1030: {
1031: 	u8		*packet_buf = NULL;
1032: 	u16		block_tag;
1033: 	u16		log_len;
1034: 	u16		tx_ready;
1035: 	u16		blk_id;
1036: 	u8		queue_id;
1037: 	free_queue_t *free_q;
1038: 
1039: 	/* maybe tx_req is from tx_complete_callback, check if there any log in queue. */
1040: 	if(pending_queue.list_out_idx == pending_queue.list_in_idx)  /* queue empty! */
1041: 		return;
1042: 
1043: 	if(log_busy_queue.free_cnt == 0)
1044: 		return;
1045: 	
1046: 	tx_ready = 0;
1047: 
1048: 	log_dev->dev_drv->io_ctrl(log_dev, SHELL_IO_CTRL_GET_STATUS, &tx_ready);
1049: 
1050: 	if(tx_ready == 0)
1051: 		return;
1052: 
1053: 	/**    ====     POP from pending queue     ====    **/
1054: 	pull_pending_queue(&block_tag, &log_len);
1055: 
1056: 	queue_id = GET_QUEUE_ID(block_tag);
1057: 	blk_id = GET_BLOCK_ID(block_tag);
1058: 
1059: 	if (queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))
1060: 	{
1061: 		free_q = &free_queue[queue_id];
1062: 
1063: 		if(blk_id < free_q->blk_num)
1064: 		{
1065: 			packet_buf = &free_q->log_buf[blk_id * free_q->blk_len];
1066: 		}
1067: 	}
1068: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_RSP_QUEUE_ID)
1069: 	{
1070: 		packet_buf = cmd_line_buf.rsp_buff;
1071: 
1072: 		if((log_dev != cmd_dev) || (blk_id != 0))
1073: 		{
1074: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req\r\n");
1075: 			/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1076: 			/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1077: 			 * rsp will not be pushed into pending queue.
1078: 			 */
1079: 		}
1080: 	}
1081: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_IND_QUEUE_ID)
1082: 	{
1083: 		packet_buf = cmd_line_buf.cmd_ind_buff;
1084: 
1085: 		if((log_dev != cmd_dev) || (blk_id != 0))
1086: 		{
1087: 			shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req\r\n");
1088: 			/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1089: 			/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1090: 			 * indication will not be pushed into pending queue.
1091: 			 */
1092: 		}
1093: 	}
1094: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_ROM_QUEUE_ID)
1095: 	{
1096: 		if(blk_id == 0)
1097: 		{
1098: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)shell_fault_str;
1099: 		}
1100: 		else if(blk_id == 1)
1101: 		{
1102: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)shell_cmd_ovf_str;
1103: 			if(log_dev != cmd_dev)
1104: 			{
1105: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1106: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1107: 				/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1108: 				 * cmd_hint will not be pushed into pending queue.
1109: 				 */
1110: 			}
1111: 		}
1112: 		else
1113: 		{
1114: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1115: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1116: 		}
1117: 	}
1118: 	else if (queue_id == SHELL_DYM_QUEUE_ID) 
1119: 	{
1120: 		dynamic_log_node *node = dynamic_list_switch();
1121: 		packet_buf = node->ptr;
1122: 	}
1123: 	#if defined(FWD_CMD_TO_MBOX)
1124: 	else if(queue_id == SHELL_FWD_QUEUE_ID)
1125: 	{
1126: 		if(blk_id == MBOX_RSP_BLK_ID)
1127: 		{
1128: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)ipc_fwd_data.rsp_buf.buf;
1129: 		}
1130: 		else if(blk_id == MBOX_IND_BLK_ID)
1131: 		{
1132: 			packet_buf = (u8 *)ipc_fwd_data.ind_buf.buf;
1133: 			if(log_dev != cmd_dev)
1134: 			{
1135: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1136: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1137: 				/* if log_dev is not the same with cmd_dev,
1138: 				 * fwd_data will not be pushed into pending queue.
1139: 				 */
1140: 			}
1141: 		}
1142: 		else
1143: 		{
1144: 				/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1145: 				shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req id=%x\r\n", blk_id);
1146: 		}
1147: 	}
1148: 	#endif
1149: 	else
1150: 	{
1151: 		/*		  FAULT !!!!	  */
1152: 		shell_assert_out(bTRUE, "xFATAL: in Tx_req %x.\r\n", block_tag);
1153: 	}
1154: 
1155: 	if(packet_buf == NULL)
1156: 		return;
1157: 
1158: 	/* rom & rsp buff not enter busy-queue. */
1159: 	if(queue_id < TBL_SIZE(free_queue))
1160: 	{
1161: 		log_busy_queue.free_cnt--;
1162: 		log_busy_queue.blk_list[log_busy_queue.list_in_idx] = block_tag;
1163: 		//log_busy_queue.list_in_idx = (log_busy_queue.list_in_idx + 1) % SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM;
1164: 		if((log_busy_queue.list_in_idx + 1) < SHELL_LOG_BUSY_NUM)
1165: 			log_busy_queue.list_in_idx++;
1166: 		else
1167: 			log_busy_queue.list_in_idx = 0;
1168: 	}
1169: 
1170: 	log_dev->dev_drv->write_async(log_dev, packet_buf, log_len, block_tag); /* send to log dev driver. */
1171: 	/* if driver return 0, should free log-block or not de-queue pending queue and try again. */
1172: 	/* if return 1, push log-block into busy queue is OK. */
1173: 
1174: 	return;
1175: }

159: 					break;
160: 				}
161: #endif  // CONFIG_BKREG
162: 			}
163: 		} while (0);

以下是对 `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp` 的静态追踪结果。未修改任何文件。

## 1. 结论摘要

CP 目前存在两条不同的日志输出路径：

### 主路径：普通 `BK_LOG`/`os_printf` 日志

在当前配置 `CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG=y` 下：

```text
BK_LOGE/I/W/D/V
  -> bk_printf_ext()
  -> shell_log_out_port()
  -> shell 日志静态/动态缓冲区
  -> pending_queue
  -> tx_req_process()
  -> shell_uart_write_async()
  -> shell_uart_tx_trigger()
  -> UART TX interrupt
  -> shell_uart_tx_isr()
  -> uart_write_byte()
  -> uart_hal_write_byte()
  -> uart_ll_write_byte()
  -> UART0 TX FIFO
  -> physical UART0 TX pin
```

这条路径具有：

- shell 日志缓冲区和待发送队列；
- SMP 下的 `spinlock`；
- 进入临界区时同时关闭本地中断；
- TX interrupt 驱动的异步输出；
- 静态日志缓冲区耗尽时可短暂等待；
- 非阻塞模式下可能丢日志并生成丢失提示。

### `BK_DUMP_OUT`/assert 路径

当前配置下：

```text
BK_DUMP_OUT(...)
  -> shell_assert_out()
  -> shell_assert_out_va()
  -> emergency_uart_write_string()
  -> emergency_uart_putc()
  -> 直接轮询 UART FIFO 状态寄存器
  -> UART0 TX FIFO
```

这条路径：

- 不进入 shell 日志队列；
- 不使用 shell 的 `shell_spin_lock`；
- 只关闭本地中断；
- 直接等待硬件 TX FIFO 有空间；
- 主要用于 assert、dump、异常上下文；
- 会与普通 shell 异步日志及 `driver.c` 的 AP bridge 直接写路径竞争。

### `driver.c` 的 AP log bridge

当前路径是：

```text
AP mailbox UART0
  -> bk_mb_uart RX ISR
  -> ap_uart0_log_rx()
  -> s_ap_uart0_log_sem
  -> ap_uart0_log_task()
  -> bk_mb_uart_read()
  -> bk_uart_write_bytes(UART_ID_0, ...)
  -> uart_write_byte()
  -> UART0 TX FIFO
```

它没有复用 shell 日志队列，也没有使用普通 CP 日志输出的 shell 临界区或锁。因此，当前实现不能保证 AP bridge、普通 CP 日志、`BK_DUMP_OUT` 三者之间的完整消息原子性和输出顺序。

```c
#if CONFIG_SOC_SMP
    spin_unlock(&shell_spin_lock);
#endif

    rtos_enable_int(flags);
}
```

这不是 RTOS mutex，而是：

```text
本地中断关闭
  + SMP spinlock
```

- `free_queue`
- `pending_queue`
- `log_busy_queue`
- 动态日志链表
- shell event flags

它不保护所有直接写 UART 的 API。

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:660-679`

```c

```

# 7. `uart_write_string` 和 `bk_uart_write_bytes`

## 7.1 `uart_write_string`

定义：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/uart/uart_driver.c:625-638`

```c
bk_err_t uart_write_string(uart_id_t id, const char *string)
{
    const char *p = string;

    while (*string) {
        if (*string == '\n') {
            if (p == string || *(string - 1) != '\r')
                uart_write_byte(id, '\r');
        }
        uart_write_byte(id, *string++);
    }

    return BK_OK;

```

性质：

- 同步；
- 每个字节都可能忙等；
- 遇到 `\n` 会自动插入 `\r`；
- 不检查 `string == NULL`；
- 不返回已写字节数；
- 不会短写，正常情况下循环直到所有字符写入 FIFO；
- 但如果 UART 未初始化、ID 无效或发生异常，当前函数本身没有状态检查；
- 函数没有 mutex；
- 函数没有关闭中断；
- 调用者需要自行保证与其他 TX writer 的互斥。

它会阻塞的原因是底层：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/uart/uart_driver.c:578`

# 10. `driver.c` AP log bridge 精确调用链

文件：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:42-121`

状态：

```c
static beken_semaphore_t s_ap_uart0_log_sem;
static beken_thread_t s_ap_uart0_log_thread;
static volatile uint32_t s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail;
```

RX ISR：

- `driver.c:50-54`

```c
static void ap_uart0_log_rx(void *param)
{
    (void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
}
```

bridge task：

- `driver.c:56-78`

```c
static void ap_uart0_log_task(...)
{
    uint8_t buffer[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];

    for (;;)
    {
        rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);

        do
        {
            length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, buffer, sizeof(buffer));

            if (length != 0)
            {
                if (bk_uart_write_bytes(UART_ID_0, buffer, length) != BK_OK)
                    s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
            }
        } while (length != 0);
    }
}
```

初始化：

- `driver.c:80-120`
- 在线程/driver init 中调用：

  - `driver.c:408-415`

```c
#if CONFIG_MAILBOX
ipc_init();
if (ap_uart0_log_init() != BK_OK)
    return BK_FAIL;
#endif
```

精确路径：

```text
bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_uart0_log_rx, NULL)
  -> AP mailbox RX interrupt
  -> ap_uart0_log_rx()
  -> rtos_set_semaphore()
  -> ap_uart0_log_task()
  -> bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, buffer, ...)
  -> bk_uart_write_bytes(UART_ID_0, buffer, length)
  -> uart_write_byte(UART_ID_0, ...)
  -> uart_hal_write_byte()
  -> uart_ll_write_byte()
  -> UART0 FIFO
```

该 bridge 自带的 semaphore 只用于：

```text
mailbox RX notification / task wakeup
```

不是 UART0 TX 互斥锁。

`bk_mb_uart_read()` 返回 `u16 length`，它可能一次只取当前 mailbox buffer 中的数据。task 会循环读取直到返回 0，但每次向 UART 写入仍然是独立的 `bk_uart_write_bytes()` 调用。

# 12. 阻塞、短写和完整性语义

## 12.1 `BK_LOG*`

在异步模式下：

- 常规情况下，调用者只负责格式化并将日志放入 shell buffer；
- 可能因为 buffer 不足而：
  - 非阻塞丢弃；
  - 生成 `some LOGs discarded` 提示；
  - block mode 下等待 `log_buf_semaphore`，每次等待 `SHELL_LOG_BLOCK_TIME=10 ms`；
- `shell_log_out_port()` 没有返回写入长度；
- 返回 `void`；
- 不能从 API 层判断最终物理 UART 是否已经发送完成；
- 日志 packet 一旦进入 `shell_uart` TX queue，实际发送由 TX ISR 异步完成。

相关位置：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:2089-2116`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:2143-2156`

## 12.2 `os_printf`

`os_printf` 映射到 `bk_printf`，最终在 async shell 模式下也进入 shell 队列。

- 返回类型 `void`；
- 可能由于日志级别过滤直接丢弃；
- 可能因为 shell buffer 不足而丢弃或短暂等待；
- 不提供写入字节数；
- 在当前配置下不直接等待 UART0 物理发送完成。

## 12.3 `BK_DUMP_OUT`

- 进入 emergency UART；
- 逐字符等待 TX FIFO；
- 可能长时间忙等；
- 没有短写返回；
- 正常情况下整段写完；
- 在 `bContinue=true` 时写完后恢复中断；
- 在 `bContinue=false` 时写完后无限循环。

## 12.4 `uart_write_string`

- 同步；
- 逐字符忙等；
- 不短写；
- 返回 `BK_OK`，但没有实际写入长度；
- 会自动插入 CR；
- 没有互斥。

## 12.5 `bk_uart_write_bytes`

- 同步逐字符发送，或配置启用时提交 DMA；
- 不短写返回；
- 返回值只有 `BK_OK`/错误；
- 当前 AP bridge 将 `!= BK_OK` 统计到 `s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail`；
- 一旦返回 `BK_OK`，在非 DMA 路径下数据已经逐字节写入 UART FIFO，但不代表已经从 TX pin 完全发送完毕；
- DMA 路径下更不代表物理发送完成。

# 13. 当前可能出现的竞争和交错

## 13.1 AP bridge 与普通 shell log

存在竞争：

```text
shell_uart_tx_isr()
  -> uart_write_byte()
```

和：

```text
ap_uart0_log_task()
  -> bk_uart_write_bytes()
  -> uart_write_byte()
```

都可以写 UART0 TX FIFO。

没有共同 mutex，也没有共同输出队列。因此可能出现：

```text
CP log A 的前几个字节
AP log B 的一部分
CP log A 的剩余字节
```

尤其是在 shell TX ISR 每次只向 FIFO 写入若干字节，而 AP bridge task 被调度或中断插入时。

## 13.2 AP bridge 与 `BK_DUMP_OUT`

两条路径都直接访问 UART FIFO：

```text
emergency_uart_putc()
```

和：

```text
uart_write_byte()
```

虽然 `BK_DUMP_OUT` 会关闭当前 CPU 的本地中断，但 AP bridge 可能在另一个 CPU 上运行，且 shell TX ISR/其他 CPU writer 不受该本地中断关闭保护。

## 13.3 `uart_write_string` 与 shell TX ISR

同样没有共同锁。

`uart_write_string` 也可能在普通任务上下文中持续发送，而 shell TX ISR 同时向 UART FIFO 写数据。

## 13.4 shell 自身的命令响应和日志

这部分是已有机制覆盖较好的区域：

- `cmd_dev == log_dev`；
- 命令响应也进入 `pending_queue`；
- `shell_task_enter_critical()` 保护 queue；
- `shell_uart` 的 TX queue 负责最终串行化。

相关位置：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:934-954`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:1029-1174`

但这个保证只覆盖通过 shell device API 进入的命令/日志，不覆盖 AP bridge 和直接 UART API。

# 14. 推荐的最小改法

目标是让 `driver.c` 中的 AP log bridge 复用已有 CP 日志机制，尽量不新增第二套 UART TX 锁。

## 推荐方案：AP bridge 不再直接调用 `bk_uart_write_bytes`，改为提交到 shell raw-log queue

优先复用：

```c
shell_log_raw_data(const u8 *data, u16 data_len)
```

已有定义：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:2029-2032`

调用链：

```text
driver.c::ap_uart0_log_task()
  -> bk_mb_uart_read()
  -> shell_log_raw_data(buffer, length)
  -> shell_log_raw_data_internel()
  -> alloc_buffer()
  -> shell_task_enter_critical()
  -> push_pending_queue()
  -> tx_req_process()
  -> shell_uart_write_async()
  -> shell_uart_tx_isr()
  -> UART0
```

需要在 `driver.c` 增加相应 shell API 头文件声明/包含，具体取决于工程的公共头文件组织方式。现有公开接口位于：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/components/shell_task.h`

这种改法的优点：

1. AP log 和普通 `BK_LOG` 进入同一个 shell `pending_queue`；
2. 复用 `shell_spin_lock + local IRQ disable`；
3. 复用 shell UART TX queue；
4. 与命令响应、普通日志共享发送调度；
5. 不需要为 `driver.c` 新增 UART mutex；
6. 保持 AP mailbox 接收线程模型不变；
7. 可以继续保留 `s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail`，但其含义应改为“shell queue submit failure”，而不是 UART driver write failure。

建议处理返回值：

```c
int ret = shell_log_raw_data(buffer, length);
if (ret == 0) {
    s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
}
```

但是需要特别注意：`shell_log_raw_data()` 内部在 buffer 耗尽时可能产生丢弃行为。它不是永不失败的可靠队列。AP bridge 代码需要明确选择：

- 接受 AP log 丢失；
- 或改用 block mode/专用静态 buffer；
- 或增加独立的 AP mailbox-to-shell 缓冲池。

对于最小改法，接受与普通 CP async log 相同的丢弃策略是最一致的。

## 不建议的方案：仅给 `driver.c` 加一个 mutex

例如在 bridge 中：

```text
lock
bk_uart_write_bytes()
unlock
```

这不能解决问题，因为：

- shell TX ISR 不会拿这个 mutex；
- `BK_DUMP_OUT` 不会拿这个 mutex；
- `uart_write_string` 不会拿这个 mutex；
- ISR 上下文不能可靠获取普通 RTOS mutex；
- 仍然可能发生 AP bridge 与 shell TX ISR 的交错。

## 不建议的方案：只调用 `shell_task_enter_critical()` 后直接写 UART

即使 `driver.c` 能访问该内部函数，也不适合作为外部 API：

- 当前函数是 `shell_task.c` 的 `static inline`；
- 只能保护 shell 数据结构，不会让其他 CPU 上的 emergency/direct writer 自动遵守；
- 直接在临界区内做长时间 UART busy-wait 会关闭本地中断，增加实时性风险；
- 会把 AP bridge 变成同步阻塞输出。

## 如果必须保留直接物理 UART 写

如果 AP log bridge 语义要求绕过 shell 队列，则最小正确方向不是只修改 `driver.c`，而是新增一个真正的统一 UART0 TX 提交 API，例如：

```text
cp_log_uart0_write()
```

由该 API：

- 统一管理一个 TX mutex 或输出队列；
- shell TX 也必须改为使用该 API；
- `BK_DUMP_OUT` 需要单独定义异常上下文抢占规则；
- direct `uart_write_string`/`bk_uart_write_bytes` 也需要迁移。

这已经不是“最小改法”，并且容易影响异常输出路径，不推荐作为第一步。

# 15. 对 `BK_DUMP_OUT` 的特殊建议

`BK_DUMP_OUT` 设计上故意绕过 shell queue，因为它需要支持 HardFault/assert 场景：

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/bk_cli/shell_task.c:2197-2202`

因此不建议让 AP bridge 复用 emergency UART path，也不建议强行让 `BK_DUMP_OUT` 获取普通 shell spinlock。

合理的边界应是：

```text
普通运行期日志：
    BK_LOG / os_printf / AP bridge
    -> shell async queue

异常/崩溃日志：
    BK_DUMP_OUT / BK_DUMP_RAW_OUT
    -> emergency direct UART
```

这样至少可以保证普通运行期 AP log 和 CP log 在同一个队列中串行化，同时保留异常路径的可用性。

不过，即便采用该方案，异常日志仍可能在普通队列数据之后或之前插入，这是故意的 emergency 语义。若需要异常日志绝对优先，需额外实现 UART owner/抢占机制，当前代码没有。
